full_prompt_en: A hand-inked color editorial cartoon shows an oddly peaceful campsite on a high rocky island surrounded by blue water. A round stone fire ring burns at the center. To its left, a brown bear sits upright like a polite guest beside a small camper; to its right, another camper in bulky outdoor clothing leans toward the flames. A low wind-shaped tree grows on the higher ledge, and a small sailboat passes in the water beyond. Distant pale cliffs and trees give the place a plausible landscape, even as the arrangement of characters makes the scene gently absurd. The viewpoint is elevated enough to see the island's irregular top and the steep rock face dropping into the water. Thin black outlines establish the animals, gear, ripples, stones, and tree, with small hatch marks and stipples describing texture. Transparent washes fill the forms in muted lake blue, moss green, gray-violet rock, tawny brown, and warm orange fire. The flame is the brightest and most saturated point; the rest of the palette stays subdued. Water occupies broad, relatively quiet areas around the crowded island. A narrow black hand-drawn border and white margin frame the square scene like a printed newspaper cartoon. The composition stays legible through its central fire and circular group, while tiny visual jokes and natural details reward a slower look. Its humor is dry, cozy, and observational rather than loud.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅手工墨线彩色编辑漫画呈现一个古怪而平静的营地，位于蓝水环绕的高岩石小岛上。中央圆石火圈正燃烧。左边，棕熊像有礼的客人般直坐在小露营者旁；右边，另一位穿厚户外装的人向火靠近。高一层台地长着一棵被风吹成低冠的树，远处水面有小帆船经过。淡色远崖和树让地点像真实风景，人物安排却使场面温和荒诞。视点足够高，可见岛顶不规则平面和陡降入水的岩壁。细黑轮廓建立动物、装备、水纹、石块和树，以小排线、点痕描纹理。透明罩染将形填为压低的湖蓝、苔绿、灰紫石、黄棕与暖橙火。火焰最亮、最饱和，其余配色低调。水在拥挤小岛周围占宽阔相对安静区域。窄手绘黑边与白边缘像印刷报刊漫画一样框住方幅。构图靠中央火与围坐的圆群保持可读，细小视觉笑点与自然细节值得慢看。幽默干冷、舒适且善于观察，并不喧闹。
style_prompt_en: Hand-inked editorial cartoon art pairs thin, slightly uneven black contour with transparent color washes. Small hatches, stipples, and short curved lines add local texture, while broad quieter color areas keep the scene easy to read. A muted blue-green field can surround a compact cluster of gray-violet, moss, and tawny shapes, with one small saturated orange focal accent. Elevated viewpoint reveals overlapping planes and a clear central circle. The linework is descriptive but never mechanically perfect; printed-paper grain and a narrow hand-drawn border can reinforce the newspaper feel. Light is even and gently natural, with darker hatch density supplying most form and shadow. The composition balances a busy, humorous focal island against spacious calm surroundings. The finish is observational, dryly whimsical, and relaxed, allowing tiny incidental details to coexist with a strong simple arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 手工墨线编辑漫画把细而略不均的黑轮廓与透明色罩染配对。小排线、点痕和短曲线增添局部纹理，宽阔较安静色域则使场景易读。压低蓝绿场可围住紧凑的灰紫、苔绿和黄棕形簇，并由一个小饱和橙色焦点强调。稍高视点显出层叠平面和清楚中央圆形。线条善描述但绝不机械完美；印纸颗粒与窄手绘边框可加强报刊感。光均匀、自然柔和，形体和阴影主要由较密排线提供。构图以繁忙幽默的焦点岛平衡宽敞平静周围。饰面善观察、干冷幽默且放松，让细小偶然细节与强简洁布置共存。
theme_en: A bear joins campers around a tiny fire on a rocky island
theme_zh: 一只熊和露营者围坐在岩石小岛上的篝火旁
name: Bob Englehart
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
